request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Use the reference only for premium dimensional craftsmanship. Completely reimagine Buki's first screen with a modern folk-craft visual system that feels universal, geometric and child-friendly. Exact text "Buki" is built from simple rounded felt-cut letters with tiny stitch accents, placed in a compact top-left brand area. Replace the old line and flower with a restrained embroidered vine made from short dash stitches and two abstract leaves, ending in a new six-petal geometric rosette symbol. The main blank portrait sketchpad uses a stitched fabric cover, a cream page with a precise dot grid and generous artwork-safe frame, a left-side loop binding, colorful triangular corner caps, and two slim bookmark ribbons. Camera control is a circular stitched medallion centered low. Palette: deep berry #A8456F, forest #3F7F6B, mustard #E6B84A, sky #6D9FD3, peach #E88768, plum #625078, warm flax #F5EBD8, paper #FFF9EF. Sophisticated handcrafted warmth, modern, premium and childy without visual noise, practical for Expo/Skia. Blank page. Exact text only "Buki". No extra writing, no device bezel, no human or mascot, no realistic environment.
